[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec loop (xs: List Int) (acc: List Int) : List Int :=
  match xs with
  | [] => acc
  | x :: [] => acc
  | x :: xs' =>
    let acc' := x :: acc
    loop xs' acc'
loop xs []
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma reverse_reverse (xs: List Int) : xs.reverse.reverse = xs :=
by
  induction' xs
  simp [List.reverse]
  simp [List.reverse, List.append_assoc]
  simp [List.reverse, List.append_assoc]
[END]

by
